implementation_summary: Added five fc.AsyncCommand<ModelStateMD, RealSystemMD> classes to e2e/tests/multi-user-md.property.spec.ts: CgCommand_MD (A1 creates group, sets groupId+membersA1+epoch), InCommand_MD (A1 invites B, settle+inviteByNpub+reloadB+selectGroup, sets membersB+epoch), LgCommand_MD(device) (locator-direct leave on device page, identity-A 2→1 semantics for A1-while-A2-in), RdCommand_MD(device, newName) (first-textbox pattern on device page), FdCommand_MD (A1 forgets A2's last leaf index, poll for leafCount-1, clears membersA2). A14 wire check deferred per spec (leaf-count consequence only). No production changes.

test_counts.note: Test body remains skipped (S1 skeleton) — S6 wires fc.assert

retrospective.harder_than_needed: The 2-party LgCommand uses `openNdkSubscriber` for A14 wire checks, which is not imported in the MD file and not part of the MD invariant set. The story spec is explicit about deferring A14, but the 2-party source code that was the reference template interleaves A14 inline — reader must consciously skip that block. Minor but non-obvious.
retrospective.surprised_by: FdCommand_MD targets the 'last' leaf index as a proxy for A2's leaf. The ratchet-tree does not guarantee insertion order maps to array position — A2 could appear at any index. This is a latent test reliability concern surfaced while implementing (captured in VQ-S4-P01).
